rapport_notes: Warm and thorough; patiently worked through a mutual mishearing of the customer's name and stayed friendly throughout.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'do you have just any kind of top of mind, concerns that I might be able to answer right off the top' — asked before address/items were probed (only basic contact info had been gathered).
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer asked directly whether protection covers damage; rep answered fully ('damage coverage... covers up to $2,000 for any kind of incidentals'), and the customer confirmed 'no, no, no, other questions [came to] mind' — concern fully resolved to the customer's satisfaction.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'you only do pay for the time that you use with us... if it takes two and a half to $3, then that's all you will pay for' (beats-it-pay-less).

top_strength: Asked the concerns/agenda question early and gave a complete, reassuring answer on damage protection that fully satisfied the customer before moving into item discovery — set up real trust early in the call.
coaching_note: On-Time Guarantee and the communication/Meet-Your-Mover pieces were never mentioned anywhere in the call — with rapport already strong and a clean close already achieved, adding those two lines before the ask would round out Stage 2 credit.
